s: kzakAraH । (ayantu kakArazakArayogena jAtaH । ato'sya pfTak varRatvaSaNkA nAstyeva .) tantramate tu vyaYjanacatustriMSavarRaH । azwamavargIyapaYcamavarRaH । ekapaYcASanmAtfkAvarRAnAM caramavarRaSca । yaTA, -- “paYcASallipiBirmAlA vihitA sarvvakarmmasu । akArAdikzakArAntA varRamAlA prakIrttitA ॥ kzArRaM meru muKaM tatra kalpayenmunisattamaH । anayA sarvvamantrARAM japaH sarvvasamfdDidaH” ॥ iti gOtamIyatantram ॥ * ॥ kaRwadeSodBavo'yam । yaTA, -- SrISiva uvAca । “viSezaM kaTayAmyadya proccAryyAH kaRWataH svarAH । fdvayaM jihvayA mUrdDnA xdvayaM jihvadantajam । muKasTAnAdDalo vAcyAH kzakAraH kaRWaGAtajaH” ॥ iti varadAtantre 10 pawalaH ॥ * ॥ asya svarUpaM yaTA, -- “kzakAraM SfRu cArvvaNgi ! kuRqalItrayasaMyutam । caturvvargamayaM varRaM paYcadevamayaM sadA । paYcaprARAtmakaM varRaM triSaktisahitaM sadA ॥ trivindusahitaM varRamAtmAditattvasaMyutam । SaraccandrapratIkASaM hfdi BAvaya sundari !” ॥ iti kAmaDenutantram ॥ * ॥ asyABiDAnAni yaTA, -- “kzaH kopastumbukaH kAlo rUkzaH sambarttakaH paraH । nfsiMho vidyutA mAyA mahAtejA yugAntakaH ॥ parAtmA kroDasaMhArO balAnto meruvAcakaH । sarvvANgaH sAgaraH kAmaH saMyogAntyastripUrakaH ॥ kzetrapAlo mahAkzoBo mAtfkAntAnalaH kzayaH । muKaM kavyavahAnantA kAlajihvA gaReSvaraH । CAyAputtraSca saMGAto malayaSrIrlalAwakaH” ॥ iti tantraSAstre varRABiDAnam ॥ * ॥ api ca । “kzakAro narasiMhaSca meruH sambarttako'pi ca । tava snehAnmayA devi ! kaTitaM mAtfkAkzaram । paryyAyErapi vijYeyaM na prakASyaM kadAcana” ॥ iti SrIrudrayAmale 8 pawale mantrABiDAnam ॥ * ॥ asya DyAnaM yaTA, -- “caturBujAM raktavarRAM SuklAmbaraviBUzitAm । ratnAlaNkArasaMyuktAM varadAM padmalocanAm ॥ IzadDAsyamuKIM lolAM raktacandanacarccitAm । SaMdAtrIYca caturvvargapradAM sOmyAM manoharAm ॥ ganDarvvasidDadevAdyErDyAtAmAdyAM sureSvarIm । evaM DyAtvA kzakArantu tanmantraM daSaDA japet” ॥ iti varRodDAratantram ॥ kzakArasya kakArazakArayogajatvena kecit pfTagvarRatvena na manyante । tezAM mate tantroktEkapaYcASadvarRAnupapattiH tantraSAstre tasya merutvena gaRanAnupapattiSca Bavati । ataH pfTaNnirdiSyate iti kecit । taTA ca । “zAntAH syuryadyapi kzAntA varRAnAmanuroDataH । pfTakkrameRa kaTyante taTApyete samanvayAt” ॥ iti viSvaprakASaH ॥ api ca । “akArAdilakArAntA varRAH paYcASadIritAH । saMyogAt kazayorezaH kzakAro merurIritaH” ॥ iti kfzRAnandaDftatantraSAstram ॥

m: 1. क्षण m. any instantaneous point of time, instant, twinkling of an eye, moment, Nal.; Śak.; Ragh. &c.
a moment regarded as a measure of time (equal to thirty Kalās or four minutes, L.; or (in astron.) to 48 minutes, VarBṛS. &c.; or 4/5 or 24/35 seconds, BhP. iii, 11, 7 and 8)
a leisure moment, vacant time, leisure (e.g. क्षणं-√ कृ, to have leisure for, wait patiently for, MBh.; cf. कृत-क्षण)
a fit or suitable moment, opportunity (क्षणं-√ कृ, to give an opportunity, MBh. iv, 666; cf. दत्त-क्षण and लब्ध-क्ष्˚)
a festival, Megh.; Daś.; BhP. iii, 3, 21
a certain day of the fortnight (as the full moon, change of the moon, &c.), Sarvad.
dependence, L.
the centre, middle, L.
क्षण n. an instant, moment, Bhartṛ. (= Subh.)
क्षण n. in a moment, Ragh. xii, 36; Śāntiś. (cf. तत्-क्षणम्)
क्षण n. ततः क्षणात् (= तत्-क्षणात्, q.v.), immediately upon that, Kathās.
क्षणात्-क्षणात्, in this moment — in that moment, Rājat. viii, 898
क्षण n. क्षणे क्षणे, every instant, every moment, Rājat. v, 165 and 337.
क्षण ˚णतु, ˚णन, &c. See √ क्षन्.
2. क्षण m. killing (= māraṇa), Gal.
a: क्षणः, --णं — [क्षणोति दुःखं क्षण्-अच्] 1 An instant, moment, measure of time equal to 4/5 of a second; क्षणमात्रमृषिस्तस्थौ सुप्तमीन इव ह्रदः R. 1. 73; 2. 60; Me. 26; क्षणमवतिष्ठस्व wait a moment. --2 Leisure; अहमपि लब्धक्षणः स्वगेहं गच्छामि M. 1; Pt. 1. 138; गृहीतः क्षणः Ś. 2 ‘my leisure is at your disposal’ i. e. I pledge my word to do your work. --3 A fit moment or opportunity; रहो नास्ति क्षणो नास्ति नास्ति प्रार्थयिता नरः Pt. 1. 138; Me. 62; अधिगतक्षणः Dk. 147. --4 An auspicious or lucky moment. --5 A festival, joy, delight. --6 Dependence, servitude. --7 The centre, the middle. --8 A certain day of the fortnight (as the full moon). (In comp. क्षण is translated by ‘momentary’, ‘temporary.’ क्षणात्, --क्षणेन in a moment, at once, immediately). --Comp. --अंतरे ind. the next moment, after a little while. --क्षेपः a momentary delay. --दः an astrologer. --(दं) {1} night-blindness. {2} water. --(दा) {1} night; क्षणादथैष क्षणदापतिप्रभः N. 1. 67; R. 8. 74; 16. 45; Śi. 3. 53. {2} turmeric. ˚करः, ˚पतिः the moon; Śi. 9. 70. ˚चरः a night-walker, a demon; सानुप्लवः प्रभुरपि क्षणदाचराणां R. 13. 75. ˚आंध्यं night-blindness, nyctalopsis. --द्युतिः f., --प्रकाशा, --प्रभा lightning. --निःश्वासः the porpoise. --भंगुर a. transient, frail, perishable; H. 4. 130. --मात्रं ind. for a moment. --रामिन् m. a pigeon. --विध्वंसिन् a. perishable in a moment. (--m.) a class of atheistic philosophers who deny the continued identity of any part of nature, and maintain that the universe perishes and undergoes a new creation every instant.

rugvinivAraRena jayet kzatAnAmasfjaSca pAtEH । kzayotTitAM kzIrajalaM nihanyAnmAMsodakaM vA maDukodakaM vA ॥ AmodBavAM vilvavacAyutAnAM jayet kazAyEraTa dIpanAnAm । gurvvannajAmulliKanErjayecca kzayaM “mUrcCAcCArdditfzAdAhastrImadyaBfSakarzitAH । piceyuH SItalaM toyaM raktapitte madAtyaye ॥ sAtmyAnnapAnaBEzajyEstfzRA tasya jayet punaH । tasyAM jitAyAmanyo'pi vyADiH SakyaScikitsitum ॥ tfzyan
